messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Error messages at Rattle startup
parts:
Very odd - perhaps some interaction with a previously saved R session
- what happens when you start up R - do you see a message that it is
restoring a session?

You can check this on starting up R:

> ls()
character(0)

If you get a list of things then it is loading an old session

You could try renaming the .RData file (if any) in the default folder
and start up R and then Rattle again. The old session is stored there.

Or else, on starting up R:

> rm(list = ls())

to completely clean up the current session, then try starting up Rattle:

> library(rattle)

Regards,
Graham

messages.subject: Re: Error messages at Rattle startup
parts:
Graham
There's nothing left over from a previous session I'm afraid. 
I used ls() to be sure.
I had the same behaviour the first time I started Rattle after I installed it.

I did notice tonight that the directory that the error message mentions was the R working directory. I used setwd to change it to a different directory, but still get the same errors when I start Rattle.

Chris

messages.author: f6f23a058361dee9
messages.subject: Re: Error messages at Rattle startup
parts:
After much rummaging I found that 3 environment variables - HOME, R_USER, R_LIBS_USER - were set to the problem directory, I don't know how or why.
By starting with a completely clean workspace and setting these variables to reasonable values, I now have rattle running with no problems.
